subject.title: Flame-tender (soldier roster v1, the caged bright)

canon.silhouette: squat and shrouded - a peaked metal hood with a deep dark face cavity, a fuel bundle breaking the outline low on one side, and a hard-rimmed iron firepot held level at chest height with a bright core boxed inside it on all four sides
canon.reads_as: the only bright thing on the field that is not the bearer, and it is carried in an iron pot

prompt.description: A flame-tender who keeps the fire fed. A peaked metal hood with a pointed cap and a deep shadowed face cavity, only a small patch of face visible inside it, eyes as dark recesses. A heavy metal apron and thick gauntlets. Held level at chest height in both hands, a squat iron firepot with a hard rim on every side; inside it a small bright core of burning fuel, boxed in by the rim on all four sides and never spilling past it. A bundle of fuel staves slung low on one side breaks the outline. Squat and wide-footed.
must_include: a peaked metal hood with a pointed cap and a deep shadowed face cavity
a squat iron firepot held level at chest height in both hands
a hard rim enclosing the firepot on all four sides
a small bright burning core inside the pot, fully boxed in by the rim, at chest height and never above the head
a bundle of fuel staves slung low on one side, breaking the body outline
eyes as dark recesses inside the hood
must_avoid: a lamp, lantern, torch or candle, and anything held up or held high
any glow, halo, rays, sparks or embers outside the pot
a free-floating light, wisp or flame detached from the body
bright pixels anywhere except inside the firepot
helmet, brim, visor, crest or plume
shield, spear, sword or any weapon
large solid black body mass, heavy internal outlining, deep recesses, cast shadow
